verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a localhost API bundled with the desktop app, a CLI that runs Anytype as a headless server, an official MCP server, and an agents skill that lets assistants like Claude Code read, search, and modify Objects. A versioned OpenAPI spec covers querying and updating objects, so agents can both read and write notes without the GUI. The 404 probe on doc.anytype.io paths does not contradict this, since the spec is published on developers.anytype.io. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that headless read/write works in practice; API v2 is still pre-release with no published deprecation policy.
